title: fix(cli): let the API pick the default voice for gen audio
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Fixed `polli gen audio "text"` failing with a 400 when no model or voice was specified: the CLI had sent `sage`, which the API’s default `openai/tts-1` model does not accept. The CLI now omits `voice` from both `GET /audio/...` requests and `--timestamps` POST bodies unless `--voice` is provided, letting the API choose its default (`alloy`). JSON output reports `voice` only when requested; CLI help and `SKILL.md` no longer describe `sage` as the default. Bumped `@pollinations/cli` from 0.1.33 to 0.1.34.
